headline: Majestic Auto tops auto ancillaries with a 16.21% annual dividend yield
hook: Majestic Auto leads sector with special payout
summary: Majestic Auto recorded the highest annual dividend yield among listed auto ancillary companies at 16.21%, largely driven by a one-time special dividend. PTL Enterprises followed in second place with a dividend yield of 6.5%. Banco Products secured the third spot with a yield of 3.79%. For retail investors, high dividend yields driven by one-time special payouts do not necessarily guarantee recurring future cash flows.
why_it_matters: One-time special dividends boost near-term yield without signaling recurring cash flow.
winners_losers: Majestic Auto shareholders gain / no clear losers

headline: Five listed companies announce special dividends ranging from Rs 10 to Rs 236 per share
hook: Extra cash for shareholders this fiscal
summary: Tata Consultancy Services, JSW Dulux, Indo Borax & Chemicals, Premco Global, Majestic Auto, and Honda India Power Products have announced special dividends for FY26. Total payouts per share varied from ₹10 to ₹236 across these firms, while their individual share price performances showed wide divergence. Special dividends provide a lump-sum cash return to shareholders independent of regular earnings distributions. Retail investors holding these stocks will see extra cash credited directly to their accounts.
whats_next: Ex-date and record date announcements for the special payouts
why_it_matters: Extra cash payouts hit your bank account soon.

headline: Small-cap dividend gems: Nine stocks offer yields of up to 16%
hook: High payouts among lesser known names
summary: Majestic Auto announced a dividend of ₹60 per share for FY 2025-26, translating to a 16.8% yield as shares rose 1.37% to ₹370 with a market cap of ₹384.71 crore. Indo Borax shares fell 3.23% while offering a ₹40 per share dividend yielding 7.9%. Other featured stocks in the list include Premco, PTC India, and Honda Power. These micro and small-cap yields offer alternative income streams for retail investors tracking high-dividend options.
why_it_matters: High dividend yields provide cash returns from small-cap holdings.
winners_losers: Dividend-focused retail investors gain / micro-cap volatility risks apply
